description_compelling: A banking-system stress event severe enough to force public intervention: deposit runs, emergency liquidity windows, recapitalizations, or asset-quality writedowns at scale. We watch the credit-to-GDP gap, NPL trajectory, and external-account pressure for the multi-year build-up. Common in emerging markets after credit booms; common in advanced economies after asset-price shocks.

coverage_audit.note: Sample-truncation audit (Majles MR-14-A1, 2026-05-25). coverage_pass=false → COVERAGE_FAIL verdict; never graded on a truncated subsample.

per_recipe_floor_provenance.note: Marcus M8-1 path-(a)/(b)/(c) provenance: see F-ML-1 §7 (civil_war_and_insurgency / cascade-inherited) or qgi-docs/internal/ops/ml-track/per-recipe-pre-reg/ (other recipes; recipe_id with `_` -> `-` is the markdown filename stem).

calibration.method: beta-3param (Kull, Silva Filho, Flach 2017) — sigmoid(a*log(p) + b*log(1-p) + c)
calibration.notes: ECE computed on the CALIBRATED probabilities (post-Beta). The verdict policy (whether LOCK requires ECE <= floor) is a methodology gate handled separately under qgi-aws-tf#969 + Majles ratification; this emit is the data the policy will consume.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
